{{MEinfobox
|name=Sanity
|cg=Sanity.png}}'''Sanity''' is a core part of the gameplay of ''[[Limbus Company (game)|Limbus Company]]''. Sanity Points (SP) are represented as a number that can be seen right next to the unit's health bar. Sanity is determined through several interactions that occur in and out of combat, and has a valid range of [-45, 45].

==Gameplay==
The formula for calculating the chance of flipping Heads on Coins according to SP is as follows:<br>
<big><math>H=50+(SP)</math></big><br>
Where <math>H</math> is the chance of flipping Heads (in %), and <math>SP</math> is the unit's Sanity Points (must be in the range of <math>[-45,45]</math>)<br>
(For example: a unit with 27 SP would have a '''50+(27)=77%''' chance to flip Heads, while a unit with -33 SP would have a '''50+(-33)=17%''' chance to flip Heads.)

The most common way to increase SP is by winning Clashes or defeating enemies, and the most common ways to decrease SP is by using E.G.O, losing allies, and other status effects such as {{StatusEffect|Sinking|d}}. (See a unit's "'''{{Icons|Unique_Sanity_Factors}}Factors Affecting Sanity'''" section for more details.)

Reaching -30 SP or lower has a chance of causing "Low Morale" on units with Sanity, activating the ''Low Morale'' effects listed in their Panic Type. However, reaching -45 SP will cause the unit to "Panic", activating the ''Panic'' effects instead. (For Sinners, Panicking causes them to not act for that Turn.)<br>
Please note that all Low Morale and Panic effects only activate on the earliest {{SkillCon|Turn Start}}.

==Corrosion==
On {{SkillCon|Turn Start}}, if a Sinner is at -45 SP and has an E.G.O with a Corrosion type Skill (essentially any non-personal E.G.O), they are forced into {{StatusEffect|E.G.O Corrosion|r}}, during which they will go out of control and use E.G.O Corrosion Skills indiscriminately.
* Additionally, if a Sinner's SP reach -45 or lower, it will be fixed at -45 until the next {{SkillCon|Turn Start}}, effectively forcing them to either Panic or Corrode. While enemy units do not have this restriction and can rise above -45 SP at any time.
* While Sinners can reset their SP to 0 after a Turn of Panic/Corrosion by default, enemy units will remain stuck at -45 SP unless they have the "Panic Recovery" Passive or any other SP-resetting Passive.

==Trivia==
<ul>
<li>Prior to the June 1st, 2023 update, the default base factors affecting Sanity were the following:
{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="border: 2px solid #810000; border-radius: 7.5px"
!style="background: #810000; border-radius: 3.25px;"|Factors affecting Sanity
|-
|style="color:#80c9ff"|
* After winning a Clash, increases based on the Clash count <br> (Base Value is 10, raised by 25% per Clash count after 1)
* If the level of the defeated enemy was higher than the unit's, increase based on the level difference <br> (Base Value is 10, raised by 10 per level)
* If the level of the enemy defeated by an ally was higher than the unit's, increase based on the level difference <br> (Base Value is 5, raised by 5 per level)
|-
|style="color:#fe4b48"|
* After losing a Clash, decreases based on the Clash count <br> (Base Value is 10, raised by 25% per Clash count after 1)
* If the level of the defeated ally was higher than the unit's, decrease based on the level difference <br> (Base Value is 10, raised by 10 per level)
|}</li>
<li>During the June 1st, 2023 update, the default base factors affecting Sanity were the following:
{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="border: 2px solid #810000; border-radius: 7.5px"
!style="background: #810000; border-radius: 3.25px;"|Factors affecting Sanity
|-
|style="color:#80c9ff"|
* After winning a Clash, increases based on the Clash count <br> (Base Value is 5, raised by 20% per Clash count after 1)
* If the level of the defeated enemy was higher than the unit's, increase based on the level difference <br> (Base Value is 5, raised by 5 per level)
* If the level of the enemy defeated by an ally was higher than the unit's, increase based on the level difference <br> (Base Value is 2, raised by 2 per level)
|-
|style="color:#fe4b48"|
* After losing a Clash, decreases based on the Clash count <br> (Base Value is 5, raised by 10% per Clash count after 1)
* If the level of the defeated ally was higher than the unit's, decrease based on the level difference <br> (Base Value is 5, raised by 5 per level)
|}
<li><li>This change was altered again on the same day into the current version of the base factors affecting Sanity.</li></li></li>
</ul>
